title: All-Weight Subsystem Distance Proof
parent_code: BT1872 [[66,13,3]]_3 finite GF3 CSS matrix code
proof_strategy: For distance 3 it is sufficient to prove no dressed logical of weight 1 or 2 and exhibit a dressed logical of weight 3. The BT1872 parent has no weight-1/2 logicals; imposing five gauge-pair commutation constraints can only shrink the logical centralizer, so no new weight-1/2 dressed logical can appear. A weight-3 parent logical survives the chosen five-gauge quotient and is not in the gauge group.

parameters.notation: [[66,8,3;5]]_3 in the finite symplectic matrix model

boundary: Exact finite symplectic-matrix distance result for the chosen gauge-pair model. It is not yet an optical decoder, hardware threshold, or physical measurement proof.
